headline: Independent Digital Broadcasting for the Filipino Public
intro: SPIN Media TV Philippines serves as the official broadcast and social media arm of the Secure the Philippines Information Network (SPIN). Operating across YouTube, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn, our newsroom connects ordinary citizens, civic leaders, and Overseas Filipinos with grounded reporting and open public affairs forums.
mission: To deliver timely, balanced, and community-rooted journalism alongside public affairs discussions that empower everyday Filipinos to examine national issues with clarity and integrity.
vision: A well-informed, resilient Philippine society strengthened by accessible independent digital media that adds genuine civic value and creates lasting significance.

coreValues.title: Adding Value, Creating Significance
coreValues.description: Every program, breaking dispatch, and community initiative is built to inform citizens practically rather than chase noise.

coreValues.title: Voice of the Ordinary Filipino
coreValues.description: Through shows like Usapang Pilipino and Suriin at Timbangin, grassroots perspectives sit side-by-side with legal and civic insight.

coreValues.title: Verified & Distinguished Reporting
coreValues.description: Our international and local bulletins explicitly distinguish verified developments from unconfirmed claims.

coreValues.title: Community & Family Empowerment
coreValues.description: Beyond politics and breaking news, SPIN Media uplifts Filipino households and recognizes civic achievers through Gawad Parangal.

affiliations: Philippine Federation of the Fourth Estate, Inc.
Community Broadcaster's Association of the Philippines
